'''Sabüm''' is an aboriginal [[Aslian languages|Aslian language]] of [[Malay Peninsula|Malaya]], extinct as of 2013.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mon-Khmer Languages Database |url=http://sealang.net/monkhmer/database/retrieve.pl?ref=Sho2006&language=Sabum&dialect=&sort=gloss&format=html |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=sealang.net}}</ref>
